summary: v39 backend regression: 18/18 tests passed covering POST /api/timetable/bulk conflict detection (intra-payload + cross-class 409), POST /api/timetable/bulk happy path with delete+insert semantics, full teacher-leaves CRUD (create/list/pending-count/active/approve/reject/delete) with auto teacher_attendance marking on approval, decision idempotency, role guards, and /api/timetable/suggest leave-aware filter that excludes approved-leave teachers for the effective week.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/teacher_leaves.py _decide() returns refreshed leave but the teacher cancellation path of an APPROVED leave only unmarks attendance and sets status=cancelled; consider also notifying the admin/teacher channel — currently only approve/reject have queue_notification. Low priority.

routes/timetable.py /bulk delete_many runs unconditionally even when intra/cross conflicts later abort with 409 — actually it runs only after the 409 check (lines 114-148), so this is fine. Verified by test_cross_class_conflict_returns_409 which confirms prior class1 slot was NOT wiped by the failed class2 submission (subsequent test_bulk_success still finds Wed-3 only when expected).

routes/timetable.py suggest leave-aware block silently swallows malformed effective_week_start in a broad except — at minimum log a warning so misconfigured payloads don't silently produce a leave-unfiltered schedule.
routes/teacher_leaves.py _working_days/_mark_attendance_for_leave both compute the same Mon-Sat range — extract a single helper to avoid drift if Sunday/holiday policy changes.

Teacher leave 'cancelled' status is allowed only via DELETE; there is no admin-driven 'revoke an approved leave' path — if school admin needs to cancel an approved leave (e.g., teacher recovered), the API only supports cancelling pending leaves cleanly; approved + DELETE by teacher does unmark attendance correctly but admin DELETE on approved is not exercised.
seed_data_creation: Test created several future-dated leaves for Priya (60d, 70d-rejected, 95d-approved, 100d-approved, 110d-cancelled, 115d-pending, and a Mon-Sat 20-weeks-out approved leave). Side-effect: teacher_attendance now has auto-marked 'leave' rows for Priya across those future weekdays.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_v39_teacher_leaves_and_timetable_conflicts.py -v. /api/classes is NOT a route — use /api/academic/classes for class listing. Auth uses HttpOnly cookies via /api/auth/login (role required in body). The test file is self-cleaning conceptually (uses far-future dates) but does leave seeded leave + attendance rows behind; that is fine for next runs as tests pick new offsets.
rca of the issue: n/a — all features behave as advertised in the review request.
